text:
nina_sales: Handoff: Clover Health signed a 3-month pilot (PO received). Go-live target 2025-09-08. Requirements summary: HIPAA BAA, SAML SSO, private control plane in us-east-1 (preferred) or dedicated pool, daily audit export to Splunk, tokenization policy for PHI, expected baseline ~20k tokens/day, peak ~9 concurrent sessions during clinics. Primary contact: renee@clover.health. Link to client pack: https://share.red/clover-pilot

rafa_cs: I'll take onboarding. Quick clarifiers: 1) Do they require a custom retention window for logs? 2) Any SIEM-specific schema needs?

nina_sales: They want 18 months retention and Splunk with HEC; will share field mapping doc in drive. No model fine-tuning. Also asked about SOC2 audit artifacts.

omar_support: Opening infra ticket. Need SAML IdP XML, VPC CIDR for peering, Splunk HEC URL + token, and signed BAA. ETA to provision private plane: ~3 business days after artifacts.

leo_eng: Perf sizing note: with ~9 concurrent and avg 550 tokens/session, private plane with a warmed small dedicated pool 0700-1700 ET should meet p99 <300ms. If they want auto-scale for bursts, budget ~+20% to cost. Need an eval prompt set (30-60) and expected session length distribution to size KV cache.

anya_security: I'll review their BAA and security questionnaire. HSM-backed key storage will be required; provisioning HSM adds ~3 business days. Also request confirmation on tokenization policy (which fields must be redacted/hashed).

rafa_cs: Action owners recorded: CS: rafa_cs (onboarding + customer comms), Support: omar_support (infra & tickets), Eng: leo_eng (sizing + perf sims), Security: anya_security (BAA/HSM + PHI controls), Sales: nina_sales (contracts + drive artifacts). I'll put together an internal runbook and invite folks to kickoff.

rafa_cs: Internal onboarding checklist (sending to customer after kickoff):
```
- Signed & scanned BAA to security@redwood.com
- SAML metadata (IdP XML) from client
- VPC CIDR + peering contact + peering SLA windows
- Splunk HEC endpoint + token + field mapping
- Eval prompt set (30-60 prompts) + critical success prompts (top 10)
- Tokenization/redaction spec for PHI
- Canary rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h steps
- Rollback criteria & telemetry thresholds
```

infra-bot: ticket CS-8642 created by omar_support - infra.provision.privateplane

omar_support: Scheduling kickoff Tue 2025-08-19 09:30am ET (placeholder). @rafa_cs please confirm and add any additional prerequisites to the ticket.

leo_eng: Plan: once we have eval set I'll run perf sims and validate q8 quant; if top-10 prompts degrade >2% we'll keep non-quant canary. Also will estimate warm pool size and KV cache sizing.

nina_sales: Renewal risk: medium. Pilot success heavily depends on timely security signoff and latency during clinic hours. If security or infra blocks >5 business days, escalate to CRO.

rafa_cs: Weekly health sync cadence proposed (Wednesdays) until pilot ends. If any blocker impacts >7 business days we escalate to Head of CS + Eng VP. I'll update this thread after kickoff with concrete due dates and owners.

nina_sales: Looping customer in to collect artifacts today; will follow up in thread when received. Thanks team :raised_hands:
